items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: And that's what Statham said, sure we've done it

ctx.x: We used to have a dog. No, no.

She's talking about dogs. Yeah. On the country there, they had a little dog that they used to have. We had a dog. We had a dog. We talked about the dog. The smaller. Yeah. We used to have dogs. I had a dog. Yeah. But the dog in there, them cron. Of course. Huh? Dog in there, them cron. They can't say, the dog cron. Dog what? Cron. I thought she was asked about the dog cron. Clon. But the poor second one kind of slain. You'd have a dog to climb up a post? They had a post cron, you know. And then the dog would go,…
By the way, did any band come around to your place
